Date: 02/18/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 55 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State Board of Genetic Counselors until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or federal funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
